description: List surf beaches (spots), optionally filtered to one zone/region, with bottom type and a short description so you can pick beginner-friendly beaches. Returns beaches, not forecasts or lessons. Great for 'which beaches are in Ericeira' or 'praias boas para iniciantes no Algarve'.

zone.description: Optional — zone/region name to filter by, e.g. 'Ericeira' or 'Lagos'. Omit for all spots.

name: list_spots
title: Surf spots
